summary: The registrant, STRATS Trust for Goldman Sachs Capital I Securities Series 2005-3, filed an 8-K to report a routine May 15, 2026 distribution to certificate holders, with details in Exhibit 99.1. No other reportable transactions or matters occurred. The trust holds junior subordinated debentures issued by Goldman Sachs, which remains subject to Exchange Act reporting. This filing is a standard periodic distribution update, not a special situation. No deal terms are present; the filing is purely informational about a scheduled payment.
